description: This file defines the Cloud9Client class in the AWS SDK for PHP, which interacts with the AWS Cloud9 service. It provides method annotations for various Cloud9 operations, including environment management and resource tagging.

classes.name: Cloud9Client
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Cloud9 service, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: createEnvironmentEC2
methods.description: Creates a new Cloud9 development environment connected to an EC2 instance.

methods.name: createEnvironmentMembership
methods.description: Adds a user to a Cloud9 environment.

methods.name: deleteEnvironmentMembership
methods.description: Removes a user from a Cloud9 environment.

methods.name: describeEnvironmentMemberships
methods.description: Describes the environment memberships for a Cloud9 environment.

methods.name: describeEnvironmentStatus
methods.description: Returns status information about a Cloud9 environment.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a Cloud9 resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a Cloud9 resource.
